name: Tickets - Repair Ticketing & Files
description: Repair ticket creation with payment gate, pool claim/assign, 5-step flow with 3-loop cap, escalation. File attachment domain with policy validation, ingestion flagging.

functions_implemented.name: create_ticket
features: OPEN status routed to Maintenance Pool

functions_implemented.name: get_ticket
features: ticket + reports + feedbacks + assignments + full event history

functions_implemented.name: validate_upload
features: returns violation codes {MIME_INVALID, EXT_BLOCKED, SIZE_EXCEEDED, EXECUTABLE_BLOCKED}

functions_implemented.name: upload
features: persist metadata row {original_name, key, mime, size, uploaded_by, entity_type, entity_id, purpose}

functions_implemented.name: list_for_entity
features: all files linked to entity (node manuals, WO attachments, ticket attachments)

core.ModuleBase: Both TicketsModule and FilesModule implement name, version, dependencies, profiles, configure/initialize/start/stop/health lifecycle
core.logger: Structured JSON logging with module namespacing
core.utils: utcnow(), new_id() for timestamps and IDs

db.org_scoped_session: All queries filtered by organization_id with RLS

api.RequestContext: Extracts org_id, user_id, role from claims

auth.require_roles: OPERATOR/MANAGER for ticket creation, MAINTENANCE for claim, MANAGER for assign/escalation decisions

tenancy.can_create_ticket: Payment gate - ORG_PAYMENT_OVERDUE error_code returned for overdue orgs

assets.node_validation: Validates service_point is ACTIVE (unless domain rule allows)
assets.for_node: TicketNodeView port for QR resolve and MCP

storage.put/get/delete/presigned_url: Used by FILES module for blob operations

worker.tasks: Future: ticket notification tasks, ingestion processing

ai.manual.ingestion_requested: FILES emits event consumed by AI module for RAG ingestion

key_features.payment_gate: TENANCY.can_create_ticket blocks ticket creation for overdue orgs with error_code=ORG_PAYMENT_OVERDUE
key_features.pool_routing: New tickets routed to Maintenance Pool (OPEN status)
key_features.claim_workflow: MAINTENANCE users can claim tickets from pool (OPEN->IN_PROGRESS)
key_features.loop_cap: 3-loop maximum between REPORT_SUBMITTED and ISSUER_FEEDBACK_REQUIRED, auto-escalates on 4th iteration
key_features.escalation_paths: Manual escalation by issuer/MANAGER, auto-escalation on loop cap exceeded
key_features.file_validation: BOTH extension AND MIME type checked, executables blocked, 10MB default limit
key_features.ingestion_flagging: Manual mark_for_ingestion for AI RAG processing (PDF/TXT/DOCX only)
key_features.duplicate_policy: Org-configured handling: REJECT, VERSION, or ALLOW based on content hash

restrictions: TICKETS never calls WORKORDERS directly - separate domains
Ticket creation blocked for orgs with OVERDUE payment state
Loop counter max 3 iterations between feedback/submit cycle
File uploads require BOTH valid extension AND matching MIME type
Executable files always blocked regardless of extension
Ingestion limited to PDF/TXT/DOCX formats only
Soft-delete for files where retention/audit requires

notes: Module follows DDD patterns established in previous chunks
Event-driven architecture: TICKETS emits ticket.* events, FILES emits file.* and manual.ingestion_requested
State machine enforces valid transitions, raises InvalidTransitionError on violations
Placeholder DB operations ready for SQLAlchemy model integration
All API routes properly secured with RBAC guards
Payment gate enforced via TENANCY.can_create_ticket port
Loop guard prevents infinite feedback cycles (max 3 iterations)
